scope: Corollary 8.1 (Character-count and defect data) of the manuscript “The Blockwise Alperin Weight Conjecture” (preprints/The-Blockwise-Alperin-Weight-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 202 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 042c7730f058d508), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 55. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B be a p-block of a finite group with defect group D of order pd, and write k(B) = | Irr(B)|. If k(B) − l(B) = 1, then the possible numerical data (pd, l(B)) are exactly the following: (i) There are positive integers n, m such that d = nm, every prime divisor of n divides pm − 1, and 4 | n implies 4 | pm − 1, with l(B) = ∑︂ e|n pem − 1 ne J2(n/e), J2(t) = t2 ∏︂ q|t q prime (1 − q−2 ). (ii) The exceptional pairs are (pd , l(B)) ∈ {(52 , 7), (72 , 8), (112 , 9), (112 , 35), (232 , 88), (292 , 63), (592 , 261)}. All listed data occur, and in every case k(B) = l(B) + 1.
